Let's talk about this. Setback's group affiliation lists him as being a part of something called the Dark Watch. But he's the only one. posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
I don't think the team name suggests magic.  If anything, my guess would be that it's a more "street"-level team akin to the Marvel Knights, though that would leave me wondering why Expat and/or Fixer aren't in it.  Perhaps there will be promo versions of them that have joined the new team, and the same might happen with Nightmist, but just as likely we'll see at least two new heroes for it.

(With probably two more members of the Prime Wardens coming, and only a projected seven new heroes impending, even a very small Dark Watch would very nearly overshadow - yuk yuk, see what I did there...hey, at least I didn't say "eclipse" - the possibilities for new heroes that lack a team affiliation.  So perhaps the theme of the next expansion will resolve around how villain escalation forces previously independent heroes to team up for the sake of self-preservation and effectiveness against the rising tide of evil...the latter threat being very likely paid off in the final expansion.)
